analysis.title: US 1: Adding FOXA & SPCX to the US 1 List; removing RNR
key_insights: BofA's US 1 Committee adds Fox Corp (FOXA) and Space Exploration Technologies (SPCX) to the US 1 List of best ideas, effective 27 October 2026.
RenaissanceRe (RNR) is removed from the US 1 List but remains Buy-rated (B-1-7).
FOXA is added at a $65.33 price, $26.0B market cap and 1.31% proposed weight. Analyst is Jessica Reif Ehrlich, rating B-1-7.
SPCX is added at a $146.90 price, $2,017.2B market cap and 5.31% proposed weight. Analyst is Ronald J. Epstein, rating C-1-9 (Buy, high volatility risk, no dividend).

The list draws on Buy-rated US-listed stocks (including ADRs) covered by BofA Global Research fundamental analysts. Stocks need average daily volume of at least $5M over six months and normally stay about 12 months.
The list holds 30 to 40 stocks (minimum 25), weighted by market cap: 2% under $100B, 4% for $100-400B, 6% above $400B. Excess or shortfall versus 100% is spread equally across all names.
Largest weights are 5.31% each for META, WMT, V, JPM, AAPL, MSFT, CSCO, NVDA, MU and the new SPCX.

Several names trade well above their addition price: MSFT (532.60 vs 372.29), AAPL (343.91 vs 247.65), V (404.16 vs 319.80), CSCO (110.24 vs 86.86), MRK (140.61 vs 111.11) and AME (242.81 vs 195.97). Several trade below: VRT (199.78 vs 248.34), CHRW (140.15 vs 169.98), BURL (241.26 vs 263.31) and MU (903.70 vs 970.82).
